summary: A qualification framework that scores a deal on eight signals. A signal only counts as proven when the buyer confirms it in their own words.
evidence_standard: A signal reaches verbatim proof only when the buyer states it. A coach claim or a rep assumption never does.
core_moves: Quantify the metric in the buyer's own numbers before you propose anything
Find the economic buyer and the paper process in the first two conversations
Score decision criteria with the buyer, not for them
Name a champion only when that person has access and a personal stake
Ask directly about competition and the build-versus-buy option

signals.label: Metrics
signals.definition: The quantified outcome the buyer must hit, stated in their own numbers.
signals.coach_hint: Ask what success looks like in the buyer's own numbers, not yours.

signals.label: Economic buyer
signals.definition: The person who can approve the spend and say no to it.
signals.coach_hint: Ask who signs the PO and who has the power to say no.

verbatim: who (signs|approves|owns the budget|has the budget|controls the budget|can sign)

signals.label: Decision criteria
signals.definition: How the buyer will score vendors, and which rules rule a vendor out.
signals.coach_hint: Ask how they will score vendors before you pitch a single feature.

signals.label: Decision process
signals.definition: The steps, owners, and timing from evaluation to signature.
signals.coach_hint: Ask the buyer to walk you through the approval path step by step.

verbatim: who else (reviews|signs off|needs to approve|needs to weigh in)

signals.label: Paper process
signals.definition: The legal, procurement, and security steps that gate the signature, with real lead times.
signals.coach_hint: Ask how long legal, procurement, and security take, in their words.

verbatim: what does the paper process look like

signals.label: Identify pain
signals.definition: The business problem the buyer is paying to fix, and what it costs them today.
signals.coach_hint: Ask what it is costing them today if nothing changes.

verbatim: what happens if you (do nothing|don't change|do not change|don't fix|do not fix)
how much (time|money|do you lose|does it cost)

signals.label: Champion
signals.definition: A person with access and a personal stake who will sell the deal internally.
signals.coach_hint: Ask what your champion would need to take this to their leadership team.

verbatim: what would you need to (take|bring|sell|pitch) (this|it) (to|in front of)
if i('m| am) not in the room

signals.label: Competition
signals.definition: Who else the buyer is evaluating, including building the solution in house.
signals.coach_hint: Ask who else they are talking to and what they are comparing you against.
